desc: 雾紫舞台气泡质感套图，主打保湿水嫩精华液卖点
name: 紫雾香槟保湿精华液款

shots.intent: 雾紫舞台大场面承接点击，让精华瓶一秒立住高级感
shots.textZone: top-third headline 「{selling_point_1}」 plus two rounded pill tags 「{selling_point_2}」 and 「{selling_point_3}」

shots.intent: 双瓶规格加彩色圆徽一秒传达核心卖点组合
shots.textZone: four pastel circle badges across the top 「{selling_point_1}」-「{selling_point_4}」 and two rounded outline pills beside the bottles 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用干燥紧绷与水润肌理的并置放大补水需求，不出现真脸
代入清晨梳妆台真实使用情境，营造水润日常感
微距一滴精华的金润质地，证明质感和延展性
四宫格编号卡片讲清质地与使用感受，消除疑虑
shots.textZone: four numbered card headlines 「{callout_1}」-「{callout_4}」 with one short body line each 「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 用产品信息栏降低决策风险，参数留空待后期填充
shots.textZone: left-column spec rows 「{callout_1}」-「{callout_3}」 with every value cell left as an empty underline placeholder

shots.intent: 并排展示大小规格让买家按需选择
shots.textZone: small size captions under each bottle reading 「{callout_4}」 and 「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 仰角气势收口，用行动按钮完成最后促单
shots.textZone: headline above the bottle 「{selling_point_6}」 and a rounded CTA button below reading 「{callout_6}」

style.backgroundSystem: misty lavender stage #B7B1E6 for hero and close shots, deep violet #6F66C8 with bubble bokeh for benefit and variant shots, pale lilac #F1EEFA and white #FFFFFF for infographic and trust screens
style.iconSystem: pastel filled circle badges and rounded outline pill tags, thin-line accents in one accent color
style.lightingSystem: soft studio key from the front-left with gentle fill, floating bubble bokeh highlights, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy lavender skincare ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty lavender #B7B1E6, deep violet #6F66C8, pearl white #FFFFFF and one champagne-gold accent #E8C87A; soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle floating-bubble bokeh and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; pastel circle-badge and rounded-pill icon style; clean high-end essence-bottle photography mixed with soft infographic elements; stable upright bottle posture and consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: bottle always upright and centered on the podium or counter, stable slight 3/4 hero posture and consistent scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: round white-marble podium top with polished chrome rim, matte marble vanity counter
